questions: Can GG-CORE link, sidecar, or reimplement Microsoft Presidio given the offline/no-network/no-in-process-Python charter?
What is the honest capability gap between Presidio and GG-CORE's regex-only PII detector?
What offline, Rust-compatible path reaches Presidio-grade detection (ONNX NER, pure-Rust patterns, eval)?

findings.summary: Presidio charter-illegal: Python+spaCy, only in-process Python API (inverts PyO3) or Flask HTTP :5002 (no C ABI/gRPC); no-network + IPC-only rules forbid both link and sidecar. MIT, ~10.2k stars

DRIFT: GG-CORE egress redaction regex+Luhn+NFKC over 13 format-structured types (pii_patterns.rs:7-33), structurally blind to NER-class PII (PERSON/LOCATION/NRP) which is Presidio's NER-only trio; 'enhanced security' overstated until measured

Offline Rust path: ONNX NER dslim/distilbert-NER (Apache-2.0, F1 0.9217) via candle-onnx simple_eval (CPU, already used) needs tokenizers crate v0.23 (http off) replacing simple_tokenize (embedder.rs:120) -> couples to issue #72; avoid Piiranha (cc-by-nc-nd + mDeBERTa op risk); reject rust-bert/ort/tch (libtorch/onnxruntime C++/network)
pii-vault v0.2.0 (MIT, 2026-04) = closest Rust artifact: regex + context scoring, 40+ types incl IBAN/crypto, zero network; dependency or pattern donor

Eval: span-level precision/recall/F1-per-type (presidio-research standard); offline corpora ai4privacy/pii-masking-openpii-1m (CC-BY-4.0) + presidio-research synthetic JSON generated-once-then-vendored; turns issue #52 governance metrics into a number
